name: Overture Places Knowledge Enrichment
description: Enriches place cards with brand, multilingual names, and structured opening hours from Overture Maps Places

overture.purpose: Match a clicked OSM place to its Overture twin to fill in brand identity, multilingual names, structured opening hours, and Wikidata cross-reference
overture.dataSent: Place name, coordinates, OSM category tag, and OSM node/way/relation ID for the viewed place

foursquare.purpose: Provide additional venue brand and hours data for commercial places via the Overture Places dataset (Foursquare is one of the Overture contributing sources)
foursquare.dataSent: No data sent directly to Foursquare; data is accessed via the locally-ingested Overture Places snapshot
